# Past Death Ghost

Past Death Ghost is a small client-side Fabric mod that marks your deaths with a translucent ghost.

When you die, the mod places a ghost at the death location and shows your death message above it as a nametag. Ghosts are saved locally, so you can return later and see where past deaths happened.

## Features

- Leaves a translucent ghost where you died
- Shows the death message above the ghost
- Saves ghosts locally between sessions
- Keeps ghosts separated by dimension
- Lets you clear old ghosts
- Lets you configure how many ghosts are kept

## Commands

`/ghosts clear`  
Clears all saved death ghosts.

`/ghosts limit <amount>`  
Sets the maximum number of saved ghosts.

`/ghosts limit`  
Shows the current ghost limit.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Java 21

## Notes

This mod is client-side. It does not need to be installed on a server.
